title: ロボティクス基礎(春期集中講義)
subtitle: Robotics Basics

(Provided by all courses)

educationalGoal: - To understand how to operate a robot by feeding back the values of various sensors. - To understand robot control programming using Lego Mindstorms and a real-time OS, and to be able to use these tools to create specific robots. - To understand PID control, the basic technology of feedback control.
advice: In this course, students learn basic robot control methods practically using a real robot car as a control target. Specifically, students learn robot control programming using LEGO Mindstorms and real-time OS, and learn how to control the robot by feeding back the values of various sensors.. Students also learn the basics of control theory such as PID control In this course, students practice robot control using LEGO Mindstorms EV3 and the real-time OS TOPPERS/EV3RT. The content of the exercise is as follows. 1) Basic robot control - Explanation of the real-time OS application development environment - Exercises using LCD and buzzer - Exercises using various sensors (touch sensors, color sensors, etc.) - Exercises using motors, Bluetooth, etc. - Multitasking programming exercise using real-time OS functions - Robot control practice based on control theory 2) Advanced robot control - Free task: Building and programming a line trace car In this course, no textbook is specified, but materials used in the class will be distributed.
requiredKnowledge: 1) Basic computer literacy (Windows and MS Office, operation of a text editor, etc.). 2) Understand the basic elements of C programming (conditional branching, iteration, functions, file I/O, pointers, etc.). Students should have taken “Introduction to IoT Programming” or have the equivalent knowledge.

activityGoals.body: To understand and be able to explain feedback control and PID control.
To understand robot programming using LEGO Mindstorms and real-time OS, and be able to create basic programs.
To be able to create specific robots using LEGO Mindstorms and a real-time OS.
